sourceFilter: DayZ building-classified objects filtered by model path/name to retain standalone buildings and building ruins; excludes walls, gates, fences, embankments, wrecks, containers, road/stream pieces, towers and small props. Includes identified military facilities, guard towers and tents from all object classes.
sortOrder: north to south, then west to east
footprintConvention: Four ordered [X east, Z north] world-metre corners of the yaw-oriented model bounds. Close the ring when drawing. yaw, pitch and roll are in degrees.
